name: Salient Volume Representation
aliases: Salient Representation via Smallest Hessian Eigenvalue
definition: A volume representation method that conveys object boundaries and narrow structures by selecting voxels based on second-order derivative operators in directions of minimal response, representing objects by their internal boundary parts.
summary: Salient Volume Representation is a sparse volume construction method that identifies significant voxels by computing the smallest Hessian eigenvalue, efficiently capturing boundaries and narrow structures with fewer voxels than gradient-based approaches.
